# bicep/images/main.bicep

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Azure Compute Gallery, image definition and identities for monthly Azure Image Builder builds.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `namePrefix` | string |  |  |
| `location` | string | `deployment().location` | Region for the gallery, its resource groups and the identities. |
| `buildEnvironment` | string | `'dev'` | The landing zone environment whose spoke holds the build subnets (snet-image-build, snet-image-aci). |
| `githubRepository` | string | `''` | GitHub repository (owner/name) whose image-build workflow may sign in as the build identity, through the "images" GitHub Environment. Empty = no federated credential. |
| `tags` | object | `{}` | Extra tags merged onto every resource group and resource. |

## Outputs

| Output | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `imagesResourceGroupName` | string |  |
| `stagingResourceGroupId` | string |  |
| `galleryName` | string |  |
| `imageDefinitionId` | string |  |
| `aibIdentityId` | string |  |
| `buildSubnetId` | string |  |
| `buildAciSubnetId` | string |  |
| `buildIdentityClientId` | string | Set as the AZURE_CLIENT_ID variable of the "images" GitHub Environment. |
